scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm normalize && prisma migrate dev --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: pnpm normalize && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:diff: pnpm normalize && mkdir -p prisma/migrations/0_init && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --script --config prisma.config.ts > prisma/migrations/0_init/migration.sql
scripts.build: pnpm normalize && prisma generate --config prisma.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json
